metadata.boundary: Create-only content-addressed whole-source artifact produced by T010 only after T009 is terminal with an exact Captain merge receipt. T010 archives exactly the T009 merge-commit tree rather than a later moving main tip. The immutable manifest binds T009 terminal/Captain receipt digests, publication PR, pre-merge base, reviewed head/tree/diff, actual merge commit/tree, predecessor ancestry, archive/content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity. T011 first consumes this artifact read-only to realize and live-prove the final receipt-bound NixOS closure; T003 later consumes the same immutable artifact and must bind that T011 closure proof before storage/cutover rehearsal.
